## Supplementary Fig. 4a
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(qs)
library(scCustomize)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
source("/users/PAS2148/tiger/Tigerrr07/scripts/R_scripts/Heatmap.R")
Cultured_seu <- qread("/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/Cultured_fibroblasts.qs")

setwd("/users/PAS2148/tiger/scRNA_analysis_code/fibroblasts")

save.path <- "Supplementary_Fig_4_figures"
if (!dir.exists(save.path)) {
  dir.create(save.path, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, fig.width = 8.5, fig.height  = 4.5}
sample_colors <- c(
  "#f5be82", "#a7dd92", "#f19d99", "#c1b1d2", "#be9e96", "#edb9d1",
  "#dbdb96", "#abd8e3", "#393b75", "#677841",

  "#3b75af", "#519e3e", "#8d69b8", "#58bbcc", "#d57bbd", "#bcbd45"
)

p <- DimPlot_scCustom(Cultured_seu, group.by = "Protocol_Passage_Condition",
                      colors_use = sample_colors)
ggsave(file.path(save.path, "Cultured_UMAP_Protocol_Passage_Condition.pdf"), p, width = 8.5, height  = 4.5)
print(p)
```

## Supplementary Fig. 4b
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width = 20, fig.height  = 16}
colors <- c('#3CA5D1', '#aacee6', '#8D8DC3', '#EF9F80', '#D28088','#9CC7BC', '#FDE3B3')

p <- DimPlot_scCustom(Cultured_seu, group.by = "annotation", split.by = 'Protocol_Passage_Condition',
                      colors_use = colors, num_columns = 4) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 5)
  )
p
ggsave(file.path(save.path, "Cultured_UMAP_seprate.pdf"), p, width = 20, height  = 16)

```
